mapper.sql: id, run_id, llm_invocation_id, tool_call_id, dispatch_index, agent_name, step_no, tool_name, tool_provider, input_json, tool_result, llm_observation, status, error_msg, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_invocation ( run_id, llm_invocation_id, tool_call_id, dispatch_index, agent_name, step_no, tool_name, tool_provider, input_json, tool_result, llm_observation, status, error_msg, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{llmInvocationId}, #{toolCallId}, #{dispatchIndex}, #{agentName}, #{stepNo}, #{toolName}, #{toolProvider}, #{inputJson}, #{toolResult}, #{llmObservation}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_invocation SET tool_result = #{toolResult}, llm_observation = #{llmObservation}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tool_invocation WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY dispatch_index ASC, id ASC

SELECT ti.id, ti.run_id, ti.llm_invocation_id, ti.tool_call_id, ti.dispatch_index, ti.agent_name, ti.step_no, ti.tool_name, ti.tool_provider, ti.input_json, ti.tool_result, ti.llm_observation, ti.status, ti.error_msg, ti.started_at, ti.finished_at, ti.duration_ms, ti.create_time, dr.request_id, dr.session_id, dr.owner_id, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM artifact_record ar WHERE ar.tool_invocation_id = ti.id AND ar.deleted = 0) AS artifact_count FROM tool_invocation ti LEFT JOIN dialogue_run dr ON dr.id = ti.run_id AND dr.deleted = 0 WHERE ti.tool_name = #{toolName} AND ti.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ti.started_at DESC, ti.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
